findings.title: Stale status polling can release recovery admission
findings.why_it_matters: A status request that captured failed before recovery starts can finish after the recovery response and overwrite its pending admission with failed. For a reopened saved plan, the task remains excluded from the archive, refresh_refine_ledger returns the failed ledger without checking the running worker, and another paid execute is admitted while recovery is generating images. The new recovery lock serializes writes but does not establish freshness of the status snapshot applied after waiting for that lock.
findings.validation_reason: For a newly reopened saved plan, a status snapshot of failed captured before recovery can reach desktop_entry.py:618-629 after recovery writes pending at :609; the threaded server (:882), copied task snapshot (pipeline_runner.py:328-331), and reopened archive exclusion (:292-294) permit this ordering, and a read-only execution of the current hook and refresh closure reproduced failed overwriting pending and bypassing the worker refresh at :362-364, thereby allowing execute admission at :478-509; production incidence was not measured.

The duration fallback in _find_unbacked_commercial_claims accepts an unlabeled duration when its numeric value/unit has one source category, even if that category conflicts with the separate title's explicit category.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep independent checks for explicitly labeled quantities, but validate a subtitle's unlabeled duration with the title's semantic context when the title unambiguously supplies that label. Preserve the existing 续航8小时 / 充电2小时 acceptance case, and add a targeted regression for title 连续续航, subtitle 8小时 against source 连续续航3小时；充电8小时.
findings.title: Preserve caption context for unlabeled quantities
findings.why_it_matters: A page titled 连续续航 with subtitle 8小时 now passes when the supplied facts say 连续续航3小时；充电8小时. Checking each field separately removes the title's endurance label, so the subtitle is treated as an unambiguous generic duration and borrows the charging value. The previous combined check rejected this false claim; the new path can authorize paid images containing an incorrect product fact.
findings.validation_reason: With source 连续续航3小时；充电8小时 and a hero caption title 连续续航/subtitle 8小时, a read-only Python reproduction of the current helper and _validate_selling_point_mapping returned no warnings while the previous combined caption check returned ['8小时']; the diff at refine_planner.py:1036-1037 newly removes the endurance context and :673-678 accepts the charging duration, with production incidence unmeasured.

testing_gaps: Recovery admission concurrency is not exercised by the new regression: test_desktop_paid_ai_safety.py:464-467 completes recover before sending execute. The existing threaded test at lines 242-270 covers execute versus execute only. Add one event-coordinated recover versus execute test, holding start_task_recovery before its response and checking that the second request cannot start another paid task, then release and verify the recovery ledger remains pending. This specifically tests the new lock spanning before_request, after_request and teardown_request in desktop_entry.py:526-528,634-636; the sequential assertion would still pass if that lock were removed.

The new admitted-recovery 500 branch in desktop_entry.py:596-601 has no corresponding failure-path coverage in the inspected paid-safety tests. Add a recovery stub that raises after admission; assert the ledger retains the recovery task ID as outcome_unknown, a later execute is refused, and a following request can complete after teardown releases the lock. Existing post-admission 500 coverage targets execute, so it cannot detect loss of unknown-outcome protection or a leaked recovery lock.
